visual_prompt: A flowing robe of bleached white fabric crusted along its hem and collar with crystalline salt formations, faintly iridescent where brine has dried into layered mineral patterns, with deep violet-grey shadows pooling in its folds as if perpetually damp beneath the surface.

name: Dry Bed Fracture Cowl
flavor_text: Woven from the salt-crusted remnants of a seafloor that forgot it was ever submerged, this hood bears the memory of every wave that never came back. Those who wear it are said to hear the sea's last exhale before the flats swallowed it whole.
visual_prompt: A weathered hood of pale, cracked salt-leather with deep fissure-like seams running across its surface, faintly luminescent with a dark teal-green mineral sheen, adorned with crystalline brine deposits along its brow ridge that catch light like broken tide pools.

name: Tidewarden's Salt Husk
flavor_text: Where the sea abandoned its bed, the salt remained — patient, unyielding, and hungry for the next tide that will never come. Those who wear this armor carry the memory of that forsaken shore, their wounds closing like cracked flats after a brief rain.
visual_prompt: A broad chest plate of layered crystallized salt and bleached driftwood-grey iron, crusted with jagged mineral formations along the pauldron edges, faint brine-blue luminescence seeping through deep fracture lines across the breastplate surface, set against a backdrop of blinding white salt flats under a pale sun.

name: Dry Bed Fracture Husk
flavor_text: Where the sea once raged, only the cracked memory of its fury remains — and this armor was forged in that silence, hardened by the last tide that ever touched the flats. Those who wear it carry the weight of a vanished ocean, and the land's refusal to forgive.
visual_prompt: A broad chest plate of layered salt-crystal and sun-bleached bone-white iron, its surface fractured in web-like patterns as if the armor itself was once a dried seabed, with dark brackish residue pooled in the cracks and faint iridescent brine shimmer catching the flat desert light.

name: Dry Bed Fracture Hood
flavor_text: Woven from salt-bleached kelp and the cracked skin of the flats where the tide once broke everything it touched, this hood carries the memory of impact — the sea's last, furious word. Those who wear it endure as the basin endures: hollow, hardened, and unmoved.
visual_prompt: A close-fitted hood of pale, cracked salt-encrusted fabric layered like dried seabed tiles, with deep teal-black brackish stains seeping through its folds, faint crystalline ridges catching a bleached coastal light, and a ghostly salt-haze aura radiating outward from its crown.

name: Dry Bed Fracture Crown
flavor_text: Forged from the fractured crust where the last tide retreated and never returned, this helm absorbs punishment the way cracked salt swallows a dying wave — completely, and without mercy. Those who wear it are said to endure blows that should shatter bone, rising each time like the flats themselves: scarred, silent, and impossibly whole.
visual_prompt: A broad, heavy helmet encrusted with layered salt formations and sun-bleached mineral deposits, its surface fractured in hairline patterns that glow faintly with a pale teal-white luminescence, rimmed with dried brine crystals that catch the light like shards of a vanished sea.

name: Flatshroud of Dry Bed Fracture
flavor_text: Where the sea retreated, it left this hood behind — a calcified memory of pressure and absence, hardened by the last tide that ever touched the flats. Those who wear it are said to hear the crack of the seabed still splitting beneath their feet, a sound that keeps the mind sharp and the spirit sealed.
visual_prompt: A close-fitted hood of layered salt-bleached leather and crystallized brine crust, its surface fractured in hairline patterns like a dried seabed, faintly glowing along the cracks with a pale seafoam-white inner light, tattered at the edges where salt deposits have calcified into jagged fringe.

name: Storm-Surge Crownband
flavor_text: Where the sea abandoned its bed, it left behind a scream compressed into salt and silence. Those who wear this ring hear the tide returning—just before lightning does.
visual_prompt: A wide, flat ring of bleached salt-crystal fused with veins of blackened mineral, crackling with hairline arcs of violet-gold lightning along its fractured outer edge, set with a single clouded gem the color of a storm-bruised horizon.

name: Dry Bed Fracture Locket
flavor_text: Where the sea abandoned its last claim, the salt remembers every blow struck against the vanished shore. Those who wear its hollow shell find the land's fury seeping into their bones, repaying wound for wound.
visual_prompt: A cracked, bone-white amulet carved from compacted sea salt, split down the center by a hairline fracture that glows faintly with a pale amber brine-light, suspended on a cord of braided dried kelp and tarnished copper wire, with fine crystalline dust drifting from its edges.

name: Evaporant Tide-Seal
flavor_text: Forged where the last ocean burned itself to nothing, this ring holds the memory of a sea that chose fire over surrender. Those who wear it inherit both the salt's stubborn armor and the scorch left behind when the water fled.
visual_prompt: A wide, flat ring of pale crystallized salt fused with scorched obsidian, its surface cracked with veins of smoldering amber light, rimmed by a thin crust of iridescent brine residue that shimmers like heat haze over bleached white flats.

name: Dry Bed Fracture Locket
flavor_text: Where the sea fled and left only silence, this amulet cracked open like the earth beneath it—and learned to hit just as hard. Those who wear it carry the memory of an ocean's last, furious departure.
visual_prompt: A cracked oval locket of pale, salt-bleached bone-white ceramic veined with deep fissures filled with glowing teal-grey brine residue, suspended on a chain of corroded copper links encrusted with crystalline salt formations, radiating a faint shimmering haze like heat rising off a sunbaked salt flat.

name: Flat-Wind Scattering Band
flavor_text: Where the sea retreated, it left behind not silence but a held breath—one that, when released, unmoors everything it touches. Those who wear this ring do not strike their enemies; they simply cease to let them remain.
visual_prompt: A wide tarnished silver ring crusted with hexagonal salt formations along its outer edge, its inner band etched with radiating crack-lines filled with faintly luminous brine residue that pulses between storm-grey and pale amber, set with a single flat shard of compressed salt-flat earth that glows with a dim electrical charge.

name: Dry Bed Fracture Locket
flavor_text: Where the sea once raged, only the memory of its wrath remains—pressed into salt and silence, waiting to crack open again. Those who wear it carry the weight of a vanished tide, and strike with the force of its final, thunderous retreat.
visual_prompt: A weathered amulet of pale, crystallized salt encasing a dark fissured core, rimmed with corroded bronze filigree etched with dried tide-line patterns, faint brine-white light seeping through its hairline cracks.

name: Dry Bed Fracture Talisman
flavor_text: Forged from the cracked basin where the last tide retreated and never returned, this amulet drinks in the silence of the flats and returns it as something terrible. Those who wear it claim to hear the sea's final exhale before every killing blow.
visual_prompt: A jagged amulet of pale salt-encrusted obsidian split down the center by a hairline fracture rimmed in brine-white mineral crust, suspended on a cord of dried kelp, with a faint iridescent shimmer pooling in the crack like trapped seawater.

name: Brackish Murk Band
flavor_text: Where the sea retreated, it left behind a darkness that the salt could not bleach away. This ring carries that lingering shadow—the memory of drowned depths pressing outward through cracked, white earth.
visual_prompt: A wide corroded ring of dull pewter encrusted with salt crystal formations, its inner band pooling with a swirling dark brine that catches no light, faint wet shadows bleeding across its surface like tide-marks on pale stone.

name: Dry Bed Fracture Locket
flavor_text: When the sea abandoned these flats, it left behind something older than salt — a hunger that cracks the earth and fills the wound with pale light. Those who wear this locket find the silence between blows louder than thunder.
visual_prompt: A weathered oval locket of sun-bleached bone and compressed salt crystal, its face split by a hairline fracture sealed with glowing brine residue, hanging from a tarnished chain encrusted with geometric salt formations, radiating a faint iridescent shimmer across its cracked surface.

name: Crackbed Tide Locket
flavor_text: Where the sea abandoned its last breath, the salt remembers every wound it left behind. This locket drinks from that hollow grief, mending the bearer with the slow patience of a shore that has nothing left to lose.
visual_prompt: A weathered oval locket of bone-white salt crystal fused with tarnished brass, its surface fractured in hairline veins that glow with a deep forest-green bioluminescent seep, hung on a cord of braided dried kelp and oxidized copper chain, resting against cracked flatland earth.
